title: Suggestion for adding the feature of panic firewall mode on
line: Vaults can now turn on firewalld's panic mode while they are open, blocking all network traffic.
explanation: Plasma Vault's only network protection was "Go offline while this vault is open", which disables NetworkManager networking and Bluetooth. Traffic that does not go through NetworkManager (manually configured interfaces, VPNs, containers, other hosts reaching the machine) is not covered, and there was no option for firewalld's panic mode, which drops every packet in and out. The change adds a per-vault checkbox under Advanced, shown when firewalld is running, and the Plasma Vault service then calls firewalld's enablePanicMode over D-Bus (with interactive polkit authorization) when the vault starts unlocking and disablePanicMode when the last such vault is locked, never turning off a panic mode the user enabled themselves and turning it off again at the next start if the service crashed with it on.

commits.message:
kded: add an option to turn on firewalld's panic mode while a vault is open

Going offline only switches off NetworkManager and Bluetooth, so traffic
that does not go through them can still get in or out. When firewalld is
running, vaults can now also turn on its panic mode while they are open.

BUG: 457368

media.caption: Master, firewalld running: vault settings > Advanced only offers "Go offline"
With the change: a new "Block all network traffic while this vault is open (turn on the firewall's panic mode)" checkbox, ticked
Master: unlocking and locking the vault, firewalld's panic mode stays off the whole time (Konsole shows firewalld's queryPanicMode and whether the vault is mounted)
With the change: panic mode turns on as soon as the unlock dialog opens, stays on while the vault is open, and turns off when it is locked
